title: Mom's Comparison
description:
Mom called.

After asking how he was eating, she said a friend's son had just passed the state exam.

Another had gotten a position at a major company.

She wasn't trying to be cruel. She just didn't know how to say she was worried about him.

choices.result_text:
"I know, I know," Mom said quickly.

"I just worry."

{name} said he understood.

He hung up and sat quietly for a moment.

She would always see the distance between where he was and where she imagined he should be. He'd accepted that.

Mom talked for another ten minutes.

So-and-so's son, such-and-such's daughter.

{name} listened.

When she finally asked again if he was eating properly, he said yes.

"Alright then. Stay healthy."

She just wanted to hear his voice.

title: Mom Comes to Seoul
description:
Mom came to Seoul unannounced.

She said she happened to be passing through. But the bus ride was three hours each way.

She brought a bag of side dishes from home.

choices.result_text:
They found a small restaurant nearby.

Mom watched {name} eat.

She didn't say much. She'd refill his water before it was half empty.

At the end she said, "You look tired."

{name} said he was fine.

She held his hand for a moment before she left.

choices.text: "Mom, you didn't have to come all this way"
choices.result_text:
"I was nearby," Mom said.

Both of them knew it wasn't true.

She handed over the side dishes and scanned his face like she was looking for something.

{name} wondered what she saw.

He walked her back to the bus stop.

title: A Moment with Mom
description:
Walking along the Han River with Mom.

She'd asked to see the river.

They walked slowly. She said, "It's big."

{name} thought about all the times he'd come here alone to think.

choices.text: Tell her honestly how things are going
choices.result_text:
It wasn't everything. But more than he'd said before.

Mom listened without interrupting.

When he finished, she said: "I knew you weren't doing it the easy way."

That was all. But her hand found his arm for a moment.

Something loosened between them.

They didn't say much.

The river was loud enough on its own.

{name} didn't need to explain. Mom didn't push.

Some things don't need words. They just need the time.
